changelog: 0-0-2 gameplay hotfix: corrected overly low shot trajectories that caused excessive net hits.
Drive, Drop and Dink shots now have more natural net clearance while still allowing genuine errors.
Contact timing window is more forgiving for smoother mobile rallies.
Opponent return trajectory and rally consistency were tuned.
All existing Pickle Que v1.4.0 queue, bookings, navigation and settings features are preserved.
